name: a-read-only-command-needs-no-plan
description: The plan gate reaches state-changing tools only: with no ledger on file at all, a command that changes nothing is allowed - and naming a protected file while reading it is still not modifying it. (The first segment was 'git status' until 2026-08-19; git left the allowlist, so this fixture keeps its point with two words that never left.)
